product_one_liner.value: DataGrail is a privacy-management platform for privacy teams to discover data, manage data-subject requests and consent, and assess privacy risk.

pricing_page.notes: No pricing link appears in the navigation or footer; the pricing URL returns a page-not-found result, while the site directs buyers to request a demo.

named_customers.notes: Both appear on the homepage customer logo wall.

employee_band.notes: Based on a reported LinkedIn employee count of 73, rather than an audited headcount.

founded_year.notes: The company quotes a founding date of May 2018.

eng_blog.notes: The blog focuses on privacy guidance, product updates, and company content; the engineering posts reviewed discuss culture and security priorities rather than providing two qualifying product-build articles.

public_docs.notes: Public documentation includes separate guides for Request Manager, Consent, Live Data Map, Risk Assessments, and an API reference.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current board lists Senior Customer Success Manager, IT & Business Systems Manager, and Senior Demand Generation Manager; none has a qualifying AI, ML, or data-science title.

model_provider.value: Claude Sonnet 5, hosted on AWS Bedrock
model_provider.notes: Vera's privacy and security documentation explicitly names this model and hosting platform.

compliance_certs.notes: Explicitly claims SOC 2 Type II certification and HIPAA compliance.

last_funding.notes: Announced October 12, 2022; the funding-history profile updated October 31, 2026 still identifies this as the latest round.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest disclosed round was in October 2022, before the specified window beginning May 9, 2025.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: An Enterprise Account Executive posting remains accessible with an Apply option, although it is omitted from the main jobs index.

launched_6mo.notes: June 2026 updates expanded Vera's access to complete RoPA records and enabled assessment workflows through Claude and other AI clients.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Christopher Wright's profile lists his DataGrail VP of GTM Ops, Growth & AI role starting June 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The demand-generation posting describes existing HubSpot infrastructure, its Salesforce sync, and responsibility for these paid-media channels.
